note: Player greet/antagonize (gameplay a1d32ef). context: warm|plain (greet), first|again (antagonize); 'lead' picks the voice. Adults only.

lines.text: You got a problem, pal? Because I'm listening.
Keep looking at me like that. See what happens.
I said move. You deaf or just stupid?
Last chance. I used to be a cop. I remember how.
Something you want to say to my face, sugar?
Keep walking. Rule two: I don't repeat myself.
You're in my way. That's a problem for one of us.
Still here? Huh. Brave or dumb. Let's find out.
I've got a razor and a bad week. Pick.
Do you know who I am? No? Good. Get out of my way.
You're blocking a man with a schedule.
Watch the suit. This suit is worth your month.
Again? In Kastoria we'd settle this behind the church.
I have lawyers. I have cousins. Which one do you want?
